# Final Stand — Server Rules
Welcome to Final Stand. By playing here you agree to abide by the following rules. Ignorance is not an excuse.
## Rule 0 — PvE Station
This is a cooperative, player-versus-environment server. Friendly fire is not intentionally enabled and must never be sought out. Do not inhibit, sabotage, or work against your fellow crew in any capacity. Violations will be acted on swiftly — tolerance is very low.
## Rule 1 — Final Stand
The station is meant to fall. Losing is part of the experience; do not become hostile or abusive when it happens. Accept the outcome and ready up for the next round.
## Rule 2 — Cash Exploiting
Generating credits by any means not intended by normal gameplay (enemy kills, shop sales, etc.) is considered exploiting. If you discover a way to create money outside of sanctioned sources, report it immediately rather than abusing it.
## Rule 3 — Erotic Roleplay (ERP)
ERP of any kind is strictly forbidden on this server. Players caught engaging in it unironically will receive warnings, temporary bans, or permanent bans depending on severity and frequency.
## Rule 4 — Hate Speech and Slurs
Slurs, hate speech, or language targeting race, gender, sexuality, religion, or nationality are forbidden everywhere on this server — in-game chat, character names, and all other communication channels. Violations result in an immediate ban.
## Rule 5 — Shop Etiquette
Each player manages their own credits; there is no shared or limited stock. Deliberately damaging or destroying the Gunshop is griefing and will be treated accordingly.
## Rule 6 — Fulfil Your Role
Make a reasonable effort to perform your department's function. Medics should be healing, Science should be researching, Engineering should be maintaining the station. Abandoning your role to the detriment of the team will not be tolerated.
## Rule 7 — Cheating and External Tools
The use of any external software, client modifications, or exploits that provide an unfair advantage is strictly prohibited. This includes aimbots, speed hacks, or any tool that manipulates the game client. Permanent bans will be issued without appeal.
## Rule 8 — Admin Interactions
Admins are here to keep the server running smoothly. Do not argue with admin decisions in-game or in public channels. If you believe a decision was unfair, raise it privately and calmly. Disrespecting or ignoring admin instructions is treated as a serious offence.
## Rule 9 — Inappropriate Content
Beyond ERP covered in Rule 3, all chat and roleplay must remain appropriate. Graphic content, shock material, and anything that would make a reasonable person uncomfortable has no place on this server.
## Rule 10 — Alternate Accounts
Ban evasion via alternate accounts results in a permanent ban on all associated accounts. If you believe your ban was issued in error, use the proper appeal process rather than attempting to circumvent it.
